english.title: Lie to employee etc of airport manager to retain identity pass - aviation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with the continued holding by

(a)_[you]_
(b)_[another]_

of an identity document already issued and to which section 21B(1) of the Aviation Security Act 1982 applied, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an employee or agent of the manager of an aerodrome in the United Kingdom, a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made to the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21B(1)(b) and (5) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also offence wordings: H2725, H2726 and H2727.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
